label: Pot timing
tooltip: When to leave for pots, abandon short pots, and whether to include reroll chests.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Min pot FATE time remaining (minutes)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Do not path to (or stay on) a pot FATE with fewer minutes left than this. Set to 0 to disable.

pot_spawn_lead_minutes.label: Pot spawn lead (minutes)
pot_spawn_lead_minutes.tooltip: Minutes before the predicted pot spawn to leave other activities and head to pots.

fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Leave for pots within (minutes)
fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a non-pot FATE when pot departure is within this many minutes. Set to 0 to disable.

ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: CE cutoff before pot departure (minutes)
ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a CE when pot departure is within this many minutes. Set to 0 to disable.

should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Include reroll pot chests
should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip: Also farm the shared reroll chest positions after a pot FATE.
